notices.obligation_basis: EU Merger Regulation Phase II timetable: the Commission must decide by a fixed deadline (statutory window); whether any new procedural act (deadline reset or extension) was issued after the Statement of Objections is not shown
notices.summary: Search-summary record (MLex paywalled, Concurrences and paper trades; evidence source_time 8 Sep 2026, knowable_from 27 Aug 2026): 'The Commission now has until 11 November 2026 to issue a final decision'; JV valued at EUR 1.42bn. Doubtful because it is a third-party summary of a date that may be an ordinary calendared statutory deadline (the ledger stores it as a scheduled-type 'mechanical' node fact) or may reflect a new Commission procedural act; the record cannot tell. No resolution bears on it (call 7, the 24 Nov lag call, and call 6, the 25 Sep null call, are unresolved).

notices.issuer_name: Servicio Nacional de Geologia y Mineria (Sernageomin)

notices.summary: Formal suspension of underground operations at El Teniente plus instruction that Codelco present four reports (cause analysis, recovery plan, fortification assessment, structural evaluation) before lifting is evaluated; date ambiguous in the record (scorer_note 'evening of 31 July', evidence knowable_from 2025-08-01, article 2025-08-04), see notes.

notices.issuer_name: Servicio Nacional de Geologia y Mineria (Sernageomin)
notices.obligation_basis: regulator's permit action lifting part of its suspension (approval of partial restart)
notices.summary: Approval (jointly reported with the Labour Directorate) on 9 August to restart eight of twelve underground sectors; Recursos Norte and Andesita stay suspended indefinitely pending engineering evaluation and remedial work.

notices.issuer_name: Labour Directorate (as named in the record)
notices.obligation_basis: labour regulator's approval needed for the partial restart (regulatory permit action)
notices.summary: Approval alongside Sernageomin, reported in one sentence with N2, to restart eight of twelve underground sectors on 9 August; may be one joint approval with N2 (see notes).

notices.summary: Six days after the 31 July stoppage Codelco asked the regulator for permission to restart part of El Teniente (reported by Reuters via US News, 6 August).

notices.issuer_name: Corporacion Nacional del Cobre de Chile (Codelco)

notices.summary: Codelco suspended development of the Andes Norte section at El Teniente for up to two years after analysis found a seismic phenomenon tied to project depth (Northern Miner, source 2026-08-05, knowable 2026-08-04); the exact date of Codelco's own statement is not in the record.

notices.issuer_name: US International Trade Commission (ALJ initial determination in the parallel trade-secrets investigation)
notices.obligation_basis: statutory Section 337 process: public version of an initial determination in a pending investigation; the determination itself is dated 24 July, so what arrived on 13 August is the public version, and its issue date is not shown as calendared
notices.summary: Public version of the trade-secrets initial determination issued 13 August 2026: ALJ recommends exclusion orders against all remaining respondents and a cease-and-desist order, which would take effect January 2027 subject to Commission review (reported by DigiTimes 2026-08-20).

notices.issuer_name: PT Freeport Indonesia (President Director Tony Wenas; joint owner of PT Smelting with Mitsubishi Materials)
notices.obligation_basis: (c) operating necessity to state a status after an outage: the owner of the halted plant confirmed the halt and gave a repair-completion timeline; PTFI is an unlisted subsidiary of listed FCX, so the record shows no exchange-rule or statutory basis, only operating necessity
notices.summary: Announced 13 Aug (as reported by the Jakarta Post, relaying Bisnis.com): smelter halted effective 8 Aug for urgent furnace repairs, completion projected Q3 2026, Grasberg production unaffected, sales timing under review. Same document also works as an event-impact statement (alt kind corporate_disclosure_of_event_impact) and is the one the record calls 'PT Freeport Indonesia's own announcement of 13 August'. Caveat: the timeline is quoted from an executive's remarks to a news outlet, so a strict reader could call it interview-form.

notices.issuer_name: PT Smelting (Gresik smelter), inferred: the record says only 'buyers were told' and names no issuer
notices.obligation_basis: (b) contractual service notice to offtake buyers (alt kind counterparty_notice) or (c) operating necessity to state a status after an outage; the record does not say which, and does not name the issuer or the contract
notices.summary: Buyers were told the plant would stay closed for checks and repairs over the coming weeks (Reuters via Mining.com, source_time 2026-08-11, knowable_from 2026-08-10). The notice's own date is not given; date_arrived is the first date the record shows it. The call-7 scorer note says buyers had 'already been told at the event', which points to the event date or just after; if it was on 2026-08-08 it is before_clock. The Reuters page itself returned 403 to the fetcher and was read through a search summary.

notices.issuer_name: Google Cloud (Google Cloud Service Health incident page, us-west1 incident of 20 Aug 2026; operator of the region, unit of Alphabet Inc)
notices.obligation_basis: (b) contract, customary post-incident account: the record's own ack_nodes obligation says an operator carrying an availability SLA across a multi-tenant region must account publicly for a multi-service failure to the tenants who will claim against it; the obligation follows from the contract, the publication date is not published anywhere
notices.summary: Root cause published 2026-08-27 (day 7) on the operator's incident page: scheduled fibre-optic maintenance compromised inter-datacentre capacity in us-west1, automated rerouting failed, congestion cascaded through Spanner Paxos consensus and the Unified Metadata Server; window 08:00-10:22 PDT on 2026-08-20 (2h22m).
